description: A drafted 請願書 / 陳情 / public-comment opinion artifact (ADR-2605312400 §3, moushibumi_compose). moushibumi ASSISTS the member in drafting; the member reviews + owns + (default) submits it. CONSTITUTIONAL: drafting-assistance, NOT 作成代理 reserved to 行政書士/弁護士 (G5; only representable assistMode is 'drafting-assist'); the member always confirms before submission (G8); the draft's content (which may include political opinion, APPI special-care) lives ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds the POINTER + metadata, never inline content.

memberDid.description: The member who owns the draft (申請者/請願者本人, G4)

sessionRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the parent participationSession

encryptedDraftRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the draft (G6); never inline content

assistMode.description: Always drafting-assist — never 作成代理 (G5). Schema-level invariant: no other value representable.

memberConfirmed.description: G8 — the member has reviewed + confirmed the draft before it may be submitted
